Spring's junk removal crew

Spring runs from the antique shops of Old Town Spring to large 1990s and 2000s subdivisions with two-car garages and big backyards, so we see everything from garage purges to backyard structures.

In Spring we most often handle garage and storage cleanouts, trampoline and playset teardowns, post-move leftovers, and furniture or appliance pickups in the subdivisions off Louetta and Spring Cypress. Spring is our home base, so it is the area we know best.

Send photos or a description, get a firm price, pick a time, and we load everything up. Zip codes we regularly serve in Spring include 77373, 77379, 77388, 77389.
